svg.title: Cross reactive TCR recognition of two DQ2.5 peptide complexes
svg.desc: Petersen 2020 demonstrates molecular cross-reactivity and natural processing of a bacterial source. The diagram does not assert that bacterial infection initiates every case of coeliac disease. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.
